thought.text: All verifications pass. Let me do a final check on the version endpoint and Vite frontend asset serving to confirm the full stack is healthy:

reasoning_content:
Excellent! All verifications passed:
1. `FINAL_LOGIN_HTTP=201` — the documented default credentials (admin@example.com / test) work and successfully authenticate the admin user (id 3, active).
2. All 27 Elasticsearch search indexes were created, including `zammad_development_ticket`, `zammad_development_user`, etc.
3. The root page returns HTTP 200.
4. The dev server is running all 5 processes (web, vite, websocket, worker, css).

Just to be safe, I'll do a few more additional verification checks:
- Check the version endpoint to confirm the app is fully functional
- Verify the frontend asset endpoints (application.css / vite)

Also, I'll make sure the Vite dev server (frontend) is serving assets correctly. After that, I'll do the final wrap-up.

I'll also check the `/api/v1/version` endpoint, which is a standard Zammad health check.

action.command:
docker exec zammad-devcontainer-devcontainer-1 bash -lc '
echo "=== /api/v1/version ==="
curl -s --max-time 30 http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/v1/version -w "\nVERSION_HTTP=%{http_code}\n"
echo "=== Vite frontend asset (3036) ==="
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "VITE_HTTP=%{http_code}\n" --max-time 30 "http://127.0.0.1:3036/assets/frontend/vite-dev/"
echo "=== application.css via rails (3000) ==="
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "CSS_HTTP=%{http_code}\n" --max-time 60 http://127.0.0.1:3000/assets/application.css
'
